descriptions.inProgress: Juliet's Lunchbox is now complete. It doesn't look all that great, but... seriously, she made this for Romeo, a person she dearly loves, so come on, it can't be toxic, right? Whatever happens to him, I'm sure the great alchemists in Magatia can save him. I'm worried about the lunchbox, but I better still give this to #bRomeo#k.
descriptions.completed: Romeo seemed very ecstatic to receive the lunchbox. Hopefully he won't die on me.
